s1w5x547.title: Apollo's five steps of awakening and their four passages
steps: Step 1, Πύθιος (Pythios): beginners who learn and inquire; the restless prisoner asks while old, rotten forces still hold the soul's oracle
Passage 1, ἀπολούων (washing): Apollo the healer cleanses what we thought we knew; it starts with the will to change
Step 2, Δήλιος (Delios): truth declared through a medium, as signs and synchronicities, like birth pangs
Passage 2, ἁπλοῦς (simple): mantic; the many opinions fall away and simple truth is known without medium
Step 3, Φαναῖος (Phanaios): direct glimpses of the One, the veil pierced for an instant
Passage 3, ἀεὶ βάλλων (ever-shooting): the archer; the will stops changing and holds one target
Step 4, Ἰσμήνιος (Ismenios): those who have knowledge, 'we know' and 'we are'; out of the cave and into mystical education
Passage 4, ὁμοπολῶν (moving the poles together): music; returning to the many to harmonise opposites, the political step
Step 5, Λεσχηνόριος (Leschenorios): dialogue and philosophy shared for the common good; life as a feast
s1w5x547.note: Five steps have four intervals, so each Cratylus etymology is the passage between two of Plutarch's names; together they make nine keys, the ennead or 'new one'. Plutarch names Delios and Phanaios together for one group of seekers; making them two separate steps is her own reading.

swh3lw3.title: The three marks of awakening
steps: Universal, impersonal love
εὐθυμία: childlike cheer, seeing life as divine play
Indifference to ego-centred goals; serving the One and all beings
swh3lw3.note: These replace false signs like aura, diet, vocabulary or lifestyle; they follow from the separate self falling away.

q131pj51.a: Union with the unknown, not knowledge of the One

tf1qozr0c.s: Realising that hidden power structures run the world counts as awakening, for her.

qz7doq7.q: What are the three marks of awakening in her talk?

pfgi1dr.title: Bring a concept to mind
steps: Bring a concept to mind: love, Apollo, light
Notice what changed around you and inside you
Ask whether you can touch or hear it
Recognise that you 'see' it noetically, not with the eyes
pfgi1dr.why: Awakening, like any idea, is noetic: it cannot be pointed at, only seen inwardly.

p10i2lwb.title: Look for the dharma in your own root
steps: Before running East, study your own tradition
Look for the practices hidden in its texts
p10i2lwb.why: Everything you seek is where you started.

p1iin8i.title: Move happiness inward
steps: Notice where you have invested happiness in objects, situations or the body
Move that foundation to your self
p1iin8i.why: Everything material can be taken away; the self cannot.

p1krz1u5.title: Read crisis as a cut
steps: See a crisis as a cut between past and future
Watch for new ideas hatching in it
Turn back to the inner source of fullness
p1krz1u5.why: Crisis is the cradle of renaissance.

p1el3du2.title: Red boundaries
steps: Keep wisdom at your centre
Set clear boundaries at your edges
Guard your gains and virtues
Call people who protect you your ἕρκος
p1el3du2.why: Creation, the soul and awakening all need guarding: the greater the treasure, the higher the walls.

p2i0gqc.title: Protect what is gestating
steps: Stay quiet, humble and close
Take only pure 'food' on every level
Avoid quarrels and shadow-boxing with those still bound
Do not be discouraged if called mad
p2i0gqc.why: The embryo of awakening is vulnerable and must be hidden from what mocks or threatens it.

p1g0euyz.title: Drop the checklist of the awakened
steps: Stop judging yourself or others by aura, diet, speech or lifestyle
Do not call yourself awakened
p1g0euyz.why: Awakening has no objective traits, and the belief 'I am awakened' shows the separate someone still stands.

p139xm7r.title: Do not force awakening
steps: Keep practising without scheduling the result
Expect it 'suddenly'
p139xm7r.why: Its hour cannot be programmed: it is Plato's ἐξαίφνης.

ps0kwr1.title: Stand up and act
steps: After meditation, add Ares: stand up
Turn insight into work and action
ps0kwr1.why: Meditation alone works mind and feeling; awakening that does not become life is incomplete.

p1cr5buw.title: Rest after awakening
steps: After an opening, stay a while
Let yourself be nourished and strengthened before acting
p1cr5buw.why: Like a newborn's 40 days, the new consciousness needs ῥῶσις, strengthening.
